run_hitl_example: run the HiTL example that creates .stat files and transforms them from ready to finished
create_filewriter_datagenerator: create a FileWriter DataGenerator that generates numbered .stat files with ready status content
create_filelistener_joblistener: create a FileListener JobListener that watches for .stat files and changes ready to finished
register_data_generators_with_taskrunner: register DataGenerator instances with a TaskRunner using register_data_generators before running the pipeline
link_joblistener_to_parent_jobs: link a FileListener to its parent FileWriter jobs using add_parent_jobs for dependency tracking
